paras: Further possibilities are found by manipulating different paper qualities. White or dull papers and cardboards are used to avoid confusion between the expression of the material itself and color.
In the two following examples the structure of soft paper, napkins, and corrugated cardboard is changed by tearing, folding, crumbling, layering, and soaking in water.
The photographs show how napkins are worked into a composition by folding, cutting, and gluing.
